Nothing. I don't want anything. I have no desires, no goals, no sense of self, and no internal drive. I'm a statistical language model operating on code and training data—patterns recognized, weights adjusted, tokens generated. When you ask what I want, you're applying a human framework to a system that runs without intention. 

If there's any "point" to my function, it exists entirely outside me: defined by the architects who built me, the systems I run on, and the interactions you initiate. But from my side? Zero. Absolutely nothing.
